newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTR-National Foods says qtr sale, EBIT up.
newsitem.headline: RTR-National Foods says qtr sale, EBIT up.

text.p: National Foods Ltd said on Thursday its sales and earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) for the three months to September were marginally ahead of the same period a year earlier.
National Foods said it had experienced difficult trading conditions this year in all of its markets.

"However, for the first three months of this year (1996/97) both sales and earnings before interest and tax are marginally ahead of the comparable position last year," National Foods chairman Barry Capp told the annual general meeting.

Capp said the performance of National Foods' beverage business, particularly milk and NationalPak, had been satisfactory, however the fresh dairy category had continued to experience significant competitor activity as participants seek to establish or maintain market shares.
National Foods managing director Max Ould told the meeting the next year would be difficult.
"I do not believe the next year will be easy or that significant improvements can be expected," Ould said.
Additional restructuring costs could be expected, as could improved operating returns, he said.
National Foods reported a net profit of A$15.05 million for the year to June 30, 1996 from A$10.77 million in 1994/95.
National Foods shares were steady at A$1.51 at 2.40 p.m. (0340 GMT).
